title: Artificial intelligence for detecting anaphylaxis in electronic medical records

live_model.evidence: "Using the primary prompt, GPT 4 Turbo detected anaphylaxis cases with 90.6% precision, 100% sensitivity, 99.5% specificity, 99.5% accuracy, and a Cohen kappa coefficient of 0.95" (Abstract; Table 1)

prompt.location: Section 2.2: five instruction items paraphrased; prompt text not quoted

claim.metric: Cohen kappa vs expert diagnosis, primary prompt

data.source: 969 Brazilian-Portuguese texts: 60 anonymized medical records (private), 29 case reports, 10 literature cases, 870 SemClinBr texts (corpus on request)

notes: Version not printed; experiments predate the Jan 2025 publication, so the date-rule resolution is uncertain. Text scraped from the Ovid page but full article present.
